I have read both the standard and your specific procedures. While the standard (CIP-007-6 R2) allows for evaluating security patches for applicability at least once every 35 calendar days [csection-7700dd5499cead0994ec], your internal procedures and operational notes demonstrate a more frequent and specific implementation:

*   **Frequency:** Your operator note specifies an "intentional_strictness" where you "evaluate patches every 30 days, not the 35 the Part allows," to ensure the evaluation does not straddle two monthly change windows [csection-440a5cdf9a6b65292ef3].
*   **Process:** Your *LSPG Security Patch Management Procedure* defines the process for "tracking, evaluating, testing, and installing applicable cybersecurity patches" [isection-168c9eef69eadf095093].
*   **Execution:** The procedure states that "At least once every thirty-five (35) calendar days, SMEs in conjunction with Foxguard, shall review all approved sources for new patches using the applicable patch evaluation workbook" [isection-21a30e0d44708f5dfdce].
*   **Implementation:** For patches determined to be applicable, your procedure dictates that "within thirty-five (35) calendar days of the evaluation, one of the following actions shall be taken: 3.5.1.1 RFC approval and installation of applicable patches; 3.5.1.2 Creation of a dated mitigation plan; 3.5.1.3 Revision of an existing mitigation plan" [isection-c75f69c881d6a214ff52].
